quote: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Decrease the speed of his or her vehicle to a speed that is reasonable and proper, pursuant to the criteria set forth in subsection 1 of NRS 484B.600 [NRS-484B-600-1a]. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation.condition: Approaching a qualifying moving or visibly preparing-to-move vehicle using required flashing lights

exceptions.description: Officer direction changes the required response; review original instruction.
exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer

judgment_calls_needed.note: Authorization, lamp qualification, movement and original pixels require independent source review.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: qualifying moving emergency or regulatory vehicle using required flashing lights

judgment_calls_needed.note: Record original speed and road/weather context without supplying a numeric legal cutoff.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: speed reasonable and proper under NRS 484B.600(1)

obligation.description: Decrease speed to a reasonable and proper speed under NRS 484B.600(1)

timing.description: Upon approach; no numeric legal speed or distance cutoff is supplied
